response.original_title: マルハン presents NOAH Jr. GRAND PRIX 2 〜LETHAL ODYSSEY TOUR 2026〜
response.overview: Jr. Grand Prix 2 ~Lethal Odyssey 2026~ was a professional wrestling event promoted by Pro Wrestling NOAH, held on November 15, 2026 at Lives NAGOYA in Nagoya, Aichi, Japan. It served as the third show for the company's annual single-elimination tournament showcasing their junior heavyweight division, and featured two such matches.
